chains.title: No TF-mediated allelic effect at chr14:55887040:C>T
predictions: No allele-specific TF binding at chr14:55887040 in MCF7 or other breast cells.
The variant remains outside annotated cCREs and has no ENCODE ChIP-seq peak containing it.
The weak molecular-QTL signal (PIP 0.03 for ENSG00000259868 in brain) does not replicate as a breast-cancer eQTL and is not explained by this base.
Any disease association would be due to a linked causal variant or passenger event, not direct TF binding at chr14:55887040.

chains.title: ESR1 binds the alt allele in a latent MCF7 regulatory element upstream of PELI2

links.claim: ESR1 is a lineage-plausible MCF7 breast-cancer TF, but E09 reports no ESR1 ChIP-seq peak containing the variant in MCF7, E03 reports no cCRE overlap, and no QBiC-SELEX model for ESR1 is provided. If ESR1 bound here, the alt T allele is proposed to bind more strongly, but this is speculative and not supported by occupancy or SELEX.

The variant is intronic/intergenic with no overlapping cCRE; the nearest dELS is 1868 bp away, so this would have to be a cryptic or poorly annotated element rather than a demonstrated regulatory element.

PELI2 is the nearest protein-coding gene at 230.8 kb, but there is no significant GTEx v8 single-tissue eQTL for this variant and the only credible-set signal is a very weak brain molecular QTL for ENSG00000259868 (PIP 0.03), not PELI2.
MCF7 is the provided breast-cancer expression context, but E09 reports no ESR1 ChIP-seq peak at this site in MCF7, so MCF7-specific ESR1 occupancy is not shown.
PELI2 has generic cancer literature and is included in a prognostic gene set, but there is no variant-specific evidence connecting this site to breast-cancer risk or progression.

predictions: ESR1 ChIP-qPCR in MCF7 should show occupancy at this position, with stronger binding to the alt T allele than the ref C allele.
The alt T allele should increase ESR1-dependent reporter activity in MCF7 if the element is active.
The element should contact PELI2 in MCF7 chromatin-contact assays.
falsified_if: No ESR1 occupancy is detected at the variant in MCF7.
Allele-specific assays show no ESR1 difference or show ref-binding more than alt.
The element does not contact or regulate PELI2 in MCF7.

MCF7 is a breast-cancer context in which FOXA1 is relevant, but E10 reports no FOXA1 ChIP-seq peak at this site in MCF7, so occupancy is not demonstrated.

predictions: FOXA1 ChIP-qPCR in MCF7 should show stronger binding to the ref C allele than the alt T allele at this position.
